capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned ethereum block 26113624 (hash 0xa8237b00d3c3b45acd6b8c3284c68a98037052ea7447b7674ce460b207a33ca2). The pinned immutable VaultV2 source routes deposit/mint through enter(), which transfers underlying assets before createShares(). Curator increaseAbsoluteCap/increaseRelativeCap and addAdapter govern allocation limits, not arbitrary recipient minting; owner/curator, deposit-gate and fee-recipient settings cannot bypass this accounting. accrueInterest() separately creates fee shares under immutable MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE (50% of interest) and MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE (5% annualized) limits, not discretionary arbitrary-share issuance. There is no local upgrade entrypoint. Inherited controls concern rlusd-ripple, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14.

review.evidence: Prior pinned reviews at Ethereum blocks 26107702 and 26113624 establish immutable VaultV2 asset-backed deposit/mint and separately bounded accrued-fee shares; zero proxy slots; owner and curator separate 1-of-1 Safes; performanceFee=100000000000000000 and managementFee=0. MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE is 50% of interest and MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE is 5% annualized. Owner appoints curator/sentinels; allocator changes liquidityAdapter/data and maxRate; sentinel deallocates, reduces caps and revokes pending changes. Fee and sendAssetsGate setters have zero delay; addAdapter/increaseAbsoluteCap have 259200-second delays. receiveAssetsGate and share-gate setters are permanently abdicated; sendAssetsGate affects deposits, not withdrawals. Underlying issuance is inherited from rlusd-ripple; parent reports are not exact-vault reconciliation or holder assurance. On 2026-10-05 at block 26124911, current vault owner, curator, sole adapter, RegistryList and delegated allocator role/designator were re-read. RegistryList owner topology, nested Safe/fallbacks, four subregistries and five referenced factories now have runtime-bound permission evidence and an explicit administrator control. The registry can append a subregistry or change its owner immediately but cannot install adapters, alter caps, replace vault bytecode or mint shares. This answers the prior unidentified-registry mutation question without certifying a complete execution scope. Delegator and DelegationManager runtimes match verified sources; their signed permissionContext/caveat inventory and EntryPoint/reauthorization bypass review remain incomplete. Original owner/curator scoped signer-custody questions remain unchanged; no independence, incident-free, prudential-supervision or favorable economic-control closure is asserted.
